data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'najja' meaning 'to be safe or secure'. Najya symbolizes triumph, safety, and victory in spiritual and life struggles. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Najya usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najya total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
